multiple: Pick as many roles as you like.
unreact: Remove your reaction to give the role back.
unpick: Pick a role again to remove it.
serverOnly: Use this panel in the server.
expired: This panel is no longer available.
gone: This role is no longer offered by the panel.
same: Nothing changed: you already have exactly these roles.
empty: No panels are configured yet: add them to the plugin config (`panels`).
need: You need the **{role}** role to use this panel.
error: Something went wrong with {role}, please try again later.
sync.reposted: posted again (the old message was gone or a new one was asked) in
dmGone: Delete the old message by hand.
commands.role-panel.name: role-panel
commands.role-panel.description: Post or refresh the role panels (edits them in place)
commands.role-panel.options.panel.name: panel
Post a new message even if the panel is still there
hierarchy: I can't change the **{role}** role: my highest role must be above it (Server settings → Roles: drag my role above it) and I need the Manage Roles permission. Please tell an admin.
channelDenied: (I cannot post or read messages in that channel)
